name: Fireshare
description: Fireshare allows you to easily share your media whether that be game clips, screen records, or movies through a unique publically accessible link. default username/password: **admin / admin** This software is currently being actively developed on. If you have feature ideas or suggestions please visit the GitHub project. Currently Supported File Types: **mp4, mov, webm** You can change the default password by setting a value for the variable ADMIN_PASSWORD. If you forget the admin password, change the ADMIN_PASSWORD to something else and restart the container.

paths.name: Processed Data
paths.description: This is where data generated by fireshare related to your shared videos will live. If this is not mapped, whenever you update the container this data will be lost and will need to be regenerated. DO NOT EDIT OR CHANGE FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY.

paths.name: Videos
paths.description: This is where fireshare will look for videos that you want to share.

paths.name: Images
paths.description: This is where fireshare will look for images that you want to share.

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The domain your fireshare instance is located. This is required for Open Graph tags to work in social media sites/apps where you share your links. (leave out http:// and https://) example: fireshare.mysite.com

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Replace with some random string. Without it, you'll be forced to login every restart of the app.

variables.name: Video Scan Interval
variables.description: How often in minutes Fireshare will scan for new videos

variables.name: Thumbnail Location
variables.description: The location in the video thumbnails are generated. A value between 0-100 where 50 would be the frame in the middle of the video file and 0 would be the first frame of the video.

variables.name: SteamGridDB Api Key
variables.description: Required for and enables game categorization.

variables.name: Enable Transcoding
variables.description: Allow Fireshare to transcode your videos.

variables.name: GPU Transcoding
variables.description: If transcoding enabled, use nvidia gpu transcoding if available.
